changelog: Prior Payment Historical Lookup in Challans: Updated LAST PAYMENT DETAIL to strictly lookup and display the student's previous paid/partially-paid challan prior to the current month.
Correct Month-to-Month Last Payment Context: Dec 2025 challan now correctly displays Nov 2025 payment details, and Jan 2026 challan accurately displays Dec 2025 paid challan details.
Strict Exclusion of Current Month Payment: Prevented current month payment data from echoing inside its own LAST PAYMENT DETAIL box.
